description:
Replaces the roles saved on the user's FoundRole account with the one role the user chose. The previous
roles are removed from the account, including a role taken from the user's resume. Recommendations then
show the new role's newest jobs in the account's place, and later searches with no title search exactly
that role. For an account with no role yet, profile_role_set saves one without removing anything.

career_profile_id.description: The FoundRole role the user chose, as careerProfileId from roles_lookup or a search question

name: profile_role_replace
title: Change the role I am looking for
